title: AI voice generation ?
author: Upbeat-Mail7201
selftext:
Hey fellow AI devs. I'm a game designer who's been working on a game with a colleague for about 1.5 years now, and we utilize AI for some things, mainly coding and optimization, as well as bot-based playtesting over extended periods. We now have a pitchable build but decided to spend another year on it since we can currently afford to and want to achieve the best possible result.



So we decided that all of our dialogue should be voiced, but we have yet to decide whether it should be actual spoken words OR gibberish that fits our "cat" characters. Since there's quite a lot of dialogue, we're wondering whether we should use voices from ElevenLabs, which could get expensive but might still be manageable, OR if we should use some kind of sound generator instead. It could also be something similar to Animal Crossing. We also thought about using mechanical voices like in Tomodachi Life, but I don't think that would fit.



Could some of you share a few examples of tools, services, or workflows that might work for this? Thanks a lot in advance!
